facts.big: The path was closed by the rain
facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio e by para quem faz: was closed by the rain, was built by volunteers.

facts.label: foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was com sujeito singular: The path was closed by the rain. O particípio dos verbos regulares termina em -ed: closed, started, checked.

facts.label: foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use were com sujeito plural: Two bridges were broken by the storm. Verbos irregulares têm forma própria: built, broken, made, found.

facts.sub: Para perguntar, ponha was/were antes do sujeito: Was anyone hurt? Was it marked on the map? A resposta curta é Yes, it was ou No, it was not.

compare.ask: The path was closed by the rain.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o caminho foi fechado pela chuva” e “a ponte foi quebrada”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The path was closed by the rain.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use was/were + particípio: the path was closed by the rain. Use were no plural: the bridges were closed. Use by para dizer quem ou o que fez a ação: by the rain, by volunteers.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The path was closed by the rain.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was closed is the passive in the past.
We say “The path closed by the rain.”
items.why: We say was closed by the rain.

items.s: With plural nouns we use were.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was closed is the passive in the past. → Verdadeiro (Was/were + participle.)
We say “The path closed by the rain.” → Falso (We say was closed by the rain.)
With plural nouns we use were. → Verdadeiro (The bridges were closed.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: By tells who or what did the action.
Was built is the same as built.
items.why: Was built is passive: someone built it.

answers: By tells who or what did the action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Was built is the same as built. → Falso (Was built is passive: someone built it.)
